classification.label: Tibeto-Burman Languages
classification.note: DLAC's regional Tibeto-Burman grouping belongs within Sino-Tibetan (sino1245), but has no equivalent node in the pinned Glottolog classification. The parent link records this broader affiliation; existing Glottolog branches are not reassigned to this group.

classification.label: Shaozhou Tuhua
classification.note: DLAC identifies Shaozhou Tuhua as a Chinese group, so it is placed under Sinitic (sini1245). Its narrower affiliation remains unresolved. Qujiang Hakka-Shibei Shaoguan Tuhua (quji1234) is only a possible partial match, not an equivalent of the entire source group.

classification.label: Danzhou Dialect (Unclassified)
classification.note: DLAC identifies Danzhou as an unclassified Chinese dialect, so it is placed under Sinitic (sini1245). A narrower subgroup, parent language, and equivalent Glottocode remain unresolved; the source's dialect label and area are retained.
